Tuya — Your AI Assistant for Living

Tuya is your all-in-one AI assistant that makes smart living simple. Seamlessly control all your connected devices, stay on top of household tasks, and get personalized lifestyle tips — all in one place. Discover a smarter, more comfortable way to live.

Why Tuya:

• Smart Home Control: Connect and manage a wide range of smart devices with just a tap or a simple voice command — it's that easy.

• Automated Routines: Create custom automations based on time, weather, or device status. Let your home run itself so you don't have to.

• Home Security: Stay connected to your home 24/7 with real-time monitoring and instant alerts when something's not right.

• Energy Insights: Track your energy usage and get smart recommendations to cut costs and reduce your footprint.

• Family Planner: Keep track of to-dos, set reminders, and share tasks with family members — nothing slips through the cracks.

• AI-Powered Life Tools: Get help with fitness goals, meal planning, meeting notes, pet care, visual recognition, and everyday tips — your personal assistant for whatever life throws at you.

• Multi-Language & Translation: Use the app in your preferred language and translate on the go for seamless communication anywhere.
